visualCharacteristics.purpose: Related research article cards with image, date, linked title and author byline
visualCharacteristics.description: Responsive 1/2/3-column grid of bordered white cards (486px wide, 20px gap at 1728px). Each card: full-bleed 2.2:1 image, date, ~22px linked title, circular author headshot with bold name and role. Whole card is clickable via the title link. Section heading stays as default content above the block.

contentPattern.description: Related research: 3 cards (Macro Vitals Show Life Despite Dead Zone for Data; Is the U.S. Job Market Losing Steam?; New Bill Poised to Unlock Pension Surpluses for Retirement Savers), each with date, author headshot, name and role.
contentPattern.structure: container block, one row per card; cells: image (reference + alt) | text (richtext: date paragraph, linked H3 title; no images) | authorImage (reference + alt, optional) | author (richtext: name paragraph, role paragraph; optional)

usage: Related research / related articles row at the end of a blog article.
reuseGuidance: Keep the section heading (e.g. 'Related research') as default content above the block. Author one row per card. Never put images in the text or author fields; use the card image and author photo fields. Visual language mirrors the Research tab of tabs-article-cards.
